snippet.title: Street Fighter 6 - Arjun Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Like an aggressive bull jumping in the dust of the fields, Arjun moves heaven and earth with his powerful breathing techniques on October 13!

Beware of his brutal blows, or he'll have you gasping for air.

Arjun can be purchased individually with Fighter Coins, and the owners of the Year 4 Character Pass / Ultimate Pass will automatically get access to him when he releases.

https://www.streetfighter.com/6/
